description: Upper bounds asserted by scripts/verify-packaged-payload.mjs for the current platform. Values are the first measured build after the 2026-09-04 size reduction with node_modules unpacked beside the ASAR and TypeScript declarations kept for the packaged App GUI compiler (DMG UDBZ 173103249; ZIP deflate-9 214292444; darwin unpackedPayloadBytes 627186432) plus 10%. The unpacked layout costs the per-file-deflated ZIP about 20 MiB versus a packed ASAR; that is the price of a working packaged compiler. Platforms without keys are measure-only until a real machine verifies them.
